fichas.title: Freight Loading Ramps and Loading Warehouses
fichas.summary: Rail freight loading ramps may be head or side ramps at or beside stores and logistics warehouses. The sheet illustrates ramp layouts, loading-road profiles, and a warehouse section. Ramp gradients, track clearances, road-vehicle swept paths, and workplace safety distances must be considered.
uses: Transferring freight between rail and road

fichas.title: Combined Transport and ISO Containers
fichas.summary: Combined transport moves goods in a single transport unit, or in the same road vehicle, across transport modes. Intermodal terminals use portal cranes to stack and transfer containers. The sheet describes ISO container sizes, inland-container widths, stacking, and special container types.
uses: Transfer goods between water, road, and rail
Transport unit goods and bulk materials
